title: Separate catalog metadata from asset construction
summary: Generated and committed 44 lightweight editor descriptors, moved picker construction to the metadata projection, and added a drift test against concrete asset and family projection. Selection ids, family associations, and browser behavior remain unchanged; full family code splitting remains isolated to the next slice.
